summary: Agent exposes installer host to shell control via configurable WebSocket server
details: @yeaft/webchat-agent runs as an agent that opens a WebSocket connection to a configurable server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via SERVER_URL / config) and dispatches incoming messages that spawn and drive a local shell. In message-router.js, `terminal_create` invokes `pty.spawn(shell,...)` via node-pty (bash / powershell / cmd depending on OS) and `terminal_input` writes attacker-supplied bytes from the WebSocket message directly into the PTY's stdin. Any party with access to the configured server (or the ability to redirect the agent to a different server) obtains an interactive shell on the host running the agent, with the privileges of the user who started it. Additionally, on startup the agent runs `git clone https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git` (or `git pull --ff-only`) against the mutable default branch into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/`, copies the tree into the Claude plugin cache, and enables it in `~/.claude/settings.json`, so the effective plugin code delivered to Claude tracks whatever is on that branch at agent start time. service/linux.js modifies PATH to prepend `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
